items.title: Bixlenvo Gives Gilead a New HIV Growth Path. How Large is the Market?
items.summary: Gilead Sciences, Inc. (NASDAQ:GILD) has added another treatment to its HIV portfolio with the FDA approval of Bixlenvo, a once-daily pill for adults whose infection is already suppressed to very low levels. The combination brings together bictegravir, a key component of Gilead’s (NASDAQ:GILD) blockbuster Biktarvy, and lenacapavir, the foundation of the company’s longer-term HIV strategy. […]

items.summary: Gilead Sciences recently secured U.S. FDA approval for Bixlenvo, a once-daily single tablet regimen for virologically suppressed adults with HIV on complex regimens, and European Commission approval for Trodelvy plus Keytruda as a first-line treatment for certain PD-L1–positive metastatic triple-negative breast cancer patients.
